request.task: Certify OBX-AUTH-R1-P2-SOLO-001 inside the complete wave-2 Release 1 governance change, with attention to the predecessor gate
request.head: ecdd4780af39f8c8678c4dfe133b8f127b29ccbd

audit.proof_assessment: Wave-2 delivers both phase records without widening the frozen ATF/T01/T02 objects, without touching package.json, package-lock.json, reviewer-roles.md, risk-exceptions/README.md, or the program ticket manifest, and without setting implementationAuthorized on the planning manifest. P1 is the only new live grant; its allowedPaths/allowedEffects are exact-pinned in the record, amendment, packet ledger, and PHASES constants, with deny-unlisted and the common forbiddenEffects floor exact-matched. P2 is recorded with implementationAuthorized false, predecessorBinding.status PENDING_PREDECESSOR_MERGE, files equal to P1 allowedPaths, disjoint effects, expiresAt = recordedAt + 336h, renewable false, and amendment.ownerDirection.recordedAt equal to the record timestamp. release-1/compatibility become owner-approved with an acceptanceRecord naming Devin Wiggins and citing the acceptance file; their boundary text still lists the unresolved decisions and is additionally pinned by the security-receipt without-packetDigest manifest hash. target-topology and program-security stay proposed. The module fails closed on non-waivable classes, glob/traversal/absolute/bare-directory/prefix paths, pin drift, expiry of the phase record or of frozen T01/T02, forged self-hash, amendment drift, and missing/stale/mislabelled/BLOCK-HIGH receipts. Predecessor gate: strong enough to stop this wave from authorizing P2 implementation (bit pinned false, flip fails, module hash-bound by security receipts, P1 must still sit unexpired in the registry). It is not a code-start interlock: verify:plans never inspects the tree, so P2-only files can be edited while the verifier still passes; shared P1/P2 paths can take P2-shaped edits under P1's live grant; and the dormant COMPLETED_VERIFIED branch accepts any 40-hex checkpointCommit and hashes current working-tree bytes rather than git show <commit>:path, so a later re-issue can claim completion without proving P1 merged.
residual_risks: P2-only paths are not tree-enforced; unauthorized P2 edits would not fail this verifier
Shared P1/P2 files (contracts, releaseLifecycleStore, pageIrController, LifecycleStatus, preview-workbench) can absorb P2 work under P1 effects
COMPLETED_VERIFIED does not resolve checkpointCommit in git or hash files at that commit
ownerAuthorizedFallback accepts any nonempty ownerAuthorizationRef without binding a real owner record
Grok receipts are excluded from security-receipt targetHashes by design; only live structural checks bind them
Effective P1/P2 window ends when frozen T02 expires (2026-09-14), ~1.5 days before the phase expiresAt
